title: Accounts Assistant
description:
As an Accounts Assistant in Cardiff, you'll support the smooth running of the accounting and finance operations for a retail business. Your role will involve managing financial transactions, ensuring accuracy, and assisting in essential reporting tasks.

Client Details

Our client is a highly successful and customer-focused business operating within the automotive sector, recognised for delivering premium products and exceptional service standards. With a strong reputation, continued growth, and a commitment to employee development, they offer a professional and supportive working environment where individuals are encouraged to develop their skills and build long-term careers. The business prides itself on teamwork, excellence, and maintaining the highest standards across all areas of its operations.

Description

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join a busy and successful finance team within a well-established automotive retail business in Cardiff.

This role will have a strong emphasis on the Purchase Ledger function and will suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices accurately and efficiently
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and goods received notes
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies
- Managing supplier queries via telephone and email
- Preparing payment runs in line with business deadlines
- Maintaining accurate supplier account records
- Assisting with month-end processes and ledger reconciliations
- Supporting the wider finance team with ad hoc accounting duties
- Ensuring compliance with internal financial controls and procedures
- Building strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders

Profile

A successful Accounts Assistant should have:
- Experience in accounting or finance roles within a similar environment.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- A keen eye for detail and accuracy in financial tasks.
- A basic understanding of financial regulations and reporting standards.

Job Offer
- A salary of 27,000
- A permanent role within the retail industry in Cardiff.
- Opportunities to develop your skills in a professional finance setting.
- Great entry level opportunity

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
EE Merthyr Tydfil Contact Centre - Part-time role - 20.0 Hours per week

Part-time shift pattern:

Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday

4:45 PM - 9 PM 4:45 PM - 9 PM 4:45 PM - 9 PM 4:45 PM - 9 PM 4:45 PM - 9 PM OFF OFF

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Merthyr is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Merthyr contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 pro-rata which goes up to £26,738 pro-rata after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Sales Support Administrator
description:
Job Title: Sales Support Administrator

Start Date: 28th September 2026

End Date: 29th January 2027

Hourly rate: 15.54 per hour

Working Days and Hours: Monday - Friday, between 8.30am to 5.30pm, totalling 37 hours each week

Location: Reading - fully office based and once trained hybrid working could then be introduced

We are looking for a highly organised Sales Support Administrator to come and join our clients team on a temporary basis. You will be supporting the sales team in a varied and busy environment checking and uploading multiple documents and contracts onto our client system.

We are looking for a candidate who is extremely organised, has high attention to detail and self-motivated. Strong and confident IT skills specifically working on Microsoft Word and Excel is essential.

Responsibilities include however, are not limited to:
- Accurately log and quote contracts
- Process and maintain a high volume of information and customer requirements
- Ensure all work is accurately logged and meeting all compliance guidelines
- Liaise with internal and external customers regarding their contracts
- Support the team with pricing, retention and renewal contract related admin
- Resolving queries and issues
- Assisting other teams and additional administrative tasks when required

To be successful the individual must have strong communication skills, a confident multi-tasker and someone who thrives within a busy team. You will be joining a growing department who have targets and tight deadlines to meet therefore you must be able to manage your own workload each day.

Previous experience working in a similar role would be ideal however not essential as full training will be provided.

Due to a very structured training plan, we cannot consider anyone who has holiday in the first 4-6 weeks of the assignment

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

PLEASE NOTE: We can only consider applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.

title: Site Administrator
description:
SITE ADMINISTRATOR

Salary: £27,000 £29,000 per annum
Location: Cardiff
Hours: Monday Friday, Days 40 Hours Per Week

We are currently recruiting for a Site Administrator to join a busy and successful organisation at their site in Cardiff.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised and proactive administrator who enjoys working within a fast-paced environment. The successful Site Administrator will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day running of the site, with particular responsibility for HR administration, employee onboarding, recruitment, time and attendance, training records and general site administration.

The ideal candidate will have strong organisational and communication skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to confidently manage multiple priorities.

Skills Required for the Site Administrator:
- Previous experience within an administration, HR administration, site administration or similar role
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Confident using Microsoft Office, spreadsheets and internal systems
- Experience maintaining accurate employee records and documentation
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately
- Comfortable communicating with employees and managers at different levels
- Ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively within a busy environment

The Site Administrator Will Benefit From:
- £27,000 £29,000 per annum
- Monday to Friday days
- 40-hour working week
- No weekend working
- Working for a successful and established organisation
- Varied role with exposure to HR, recruitment and site operations
- Opportunity to develop administrative and HR experience
- Training and development opportunities
- Stable and supportive working environment

Duties of the Site Administrator:
- Manage the time and attendance system, including running weekly clocking reports
- Support the complete new starter and onboarding process, including induction packs, contracts, system updates, welcome packs and uniforms
- Prepare weekly and monthly employee returns in conjunction with the General Manager
- Maintain accurate absence records and Bradford Factor scores
- Track and maintain Right to Work documentation for new and existing employees
- Maintain HR systems, spreadsheets and employee trackers, including probation periods, exit interviews and Right to Work records
- Ensure personnel files and general filing are accurate and kept up to date
- Prepare documentation for disciplinary, grievance and welfare meetings in conjunction with the Regional HR Advisor
- Support internal audits when required
- Coordinate annual training reminders and associated paperwork with line managers
- Support the site's recruitment process, including advertising vacancies, arranging interviews, attending job fairs and completing relevant paperwork
- Support HR projects, employee engagement initiatives and focus groups
- Administer holiday records for weekly and monthly employees
- Take and distribute minutes from on-site meetings
- Ensure site noticeboards contain relevant and up-to-date information

If you are interested in this role and feel that you have the right skills and experience, then please click apply at the bottom of this advert or contact Pioneer Selection for further information.
